sources.title: AMD-OLMo-1B - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: AMD-OLMo AMD-OLMo are a series of 1B language models trained from scratch by AMD on AMD Instinct™ MI250 GPUs. The training code used is based on OLMo. We release the pre-trained model, supervised fine-tuned model, and DPO aligned model as follows: AMD-OLMo-1B: Pre-trained on a subset of Dolma v1.7 that consists of 1.3 trillion tokens.
